issues.description: The rendered conclusion card has a much larger corner radius than the source, while the source's fully pill-shaped principles badge is rendered with only slightly rounded corners. This reverses the source's card-versus-pill shape hierarchy and is conspicuous across the entire right panel.

changes.conclusion-card.radius: reduce to the source's restrained rounded-card radius
changes.principles-badge.radius: increase to a full pill radius matching half the badge height

issues.description: Text in the right panel renders slightly larger and heavier than in the source, most noticeably in the heading, bullet lines, and badge label, although wording, alignment, and hierarchy remain intact.

changes.font_size: reduce the right-panel heading, body, and badge text slightly to match the source's apparent size
changes.font_weight: match the source's lighter apparent weight

background_seams.rationale: The pale background and clipped decorative circles remain continuous, with no hard rectangular seams or mismatched local patches.

connector_endpoints.rationale: The source contains no connectors or arrowheads whose endpoints require evaluation.

connector_topology.rationale: The source is a two-panel editorial layout and contains no semantic connectors, branches, merges, or loops.

crop_boundaries.rationale: The landscape asset preserves the source crop, focal subject, alignment, white edge treatment, and corner behavior without introducing a new opaque rectangular tile or halo.

key_proportions.rationale: The landscape panel, conclusion panel, margins, spacing, and overall left-right balance closely match the source.

typography_hierarchy.rationale: The title hierarchy and alignment are preserved, but the right-panel heading, body, and badge text are visibly larger and heavier than the source.

visual_depth.rationale: The source's restrained rounded card and fully rounded badge establish a clear border-and-shape hierarchy, but the render reverses those corner-radius cues.
